_comment: Optional per-company overrides for networking_daily.py and contact_extract.py, keyed by normalized company name (lowercase, legal suffixes stripped — the same form normalize.norm_company produces). Size and product lines are read live from the Greenhouse board, so they are NOT set here. Only add an entry when a company has a team page worth fetching or an email domain worth a Hunter.io lookup. Safe to commit — public information only.
